title: You bought Rome. Worst job ever.
version: v3 (Chatterbox Finn, Sprechweise nach Vorbild ricksclip3000; Fakten unverändert aus v2)
note: v3: Texte im Stil der vom Nutzer gelobten Probe (kurze Sätze, Frage-Hook, 'Well,' als Wende, trockene Pointe, keine '…'-Pausen, Zahlen ausgeschrieben). Loop: letzte Worte 'It went downhill the day someone asked,' führen in den ersten Satz 'What if you could buy the Roman Empire?'. Beats/Sticker/HUD wie v2, nur an neue Cue-Wörter gebunden. 'say'-Schreibweisen (Kokoro) entfernt, Aussprache per Whisper prüfen. Story: YOU (one Toonie, purple ImperialCloak + LaurelWreath, same figure all video) keeps 'respawning' into the job of emperor, and each respawn is a harder mode: 193 Julianus -> 238 skipped respawn (beat nopeSkip) -> 395 Honorius (HARD MODE) -> 410/455 Honorius' West falls apart, YOU waits in a 'RESPAWNING…' queue during 455 -> 475 Augustulus (NIGHTMARE MODE) -> 476 deposed, job deleted. HUD: YEAR climbs, EMPIRE bar sinks (first drop on 'hates'), pumps back up at the East twist. Loop: last words '...It went downhill the day' lead straight into the first line 'the Roman Empire got auctioned off.' Delivery: lively and upbeat; short sentences, '!' and '?' plus '…' for comic pauses.

scenes.text: What if you could buy the Roman Empire? Like, actually buy it, at an *auction*. Well, in the year one ninety-three, someone did, and today that someone is you. Congrats, Emperor! Bad news, though: every time you respawn, this job gets *worse*.
scenes.visual: Late afternoon / dusk (not night), Praetorian camp outside Rome: a bid board and the Throne on a stage, RomanSkyline behind; YOU (Toonie in ImperialCloak + LaurelWreath) jumps up as Legionary guards point at him. Close-up of YOU grinning on the Throne, then a slow push-in on his worried face at 'worse'.

scenes.text: Rewind to one ninety-three. The guards just killed the last emperor after eighty-seven days, and now they're selling the throne. Your rival bids inside, while you shout from outside. Then you flash your fingers, five thousand more, *twenty-five thousand* per soldier. Sold!
scenes.visual: Dusk, camp wall with gate: rival in Toga (Senator) bidding from inside, YOU outside the gate shouting, Legionary guards with Scutum on the wall between them; Coin stacks grow beside each bidder. Detail shot: YOU holding up his fingers to show the raise, then the guards cheer.

scenes.text: But Rome hates you. People curse you and throw stones at you, and after sixty-six days it's *game over*. Your last words? "Whom have I killed?" Buddy, you *bought* an empire.
scenes.visual: Forum with Temple and Columns: a crowd of Senators/citizens boos YOU, small stones fly, YOU ducks with raised hand. Then a 66-days sticker, DangerLight goes red, a GAME OVER-style freeze, and a close-up of YOU looking innocently into the camera for the last words.

scenes.text: So, one ninety-three gets five emperors in one year. Next respawn, two thirty-eight? Six rulers dead in a few months. *Nope*.
scenes.visual: Five Emperor Toonies on a fast-spinning Throne carousel (each pops off), then the TimelineStele flicks forward to 238 with six small wreaths falling; YOU waves 'nope' and the stele fast-forwards again (skipped respawn).

scenes.text: Respawn. Three ninety-five, *hard mode*. The empire splits in two. Your brother gets the East, and you're *Honorius*, Emperor of the West. Legend says you keep a huge rooster. Its name? Rome.
scenes.visual: EmpireMap seen from above cracks in two (split), brother Emperor walks off to the right/East, YOU stays on the West half. Cut to YOU's palace: YOU on the Throne cuddling a very large rooster (rooster prop still needed in rome.tsx) with a name tag 'ROME'.

scenes.text: But in four ten, the Goths loot your city. How? One story says three hundred young men get sent as a gift. Then they open the gate. A *Trojan Horse*, but with people.
scenes.visual: Rome's city gate at bright midday with a SoftSun overhead: a line of young Goths (GothCap, BarbarianTunic, no fur) with a big gift bow slips inside and swings the gate open; the Goth army with RoundShields and Spears floods in, Rubble flies. Gag shot: a giant wooden horse silhouette dissolves into the line of young men.

scenes.text: As the story goes, your rooster guy brings news. "Rome has perished!" You cry, "And yet it just ate from my hands!" He means the city. And you? *Relieved*.
scenes.visual: Back in YOU's palace: a nervous servant in a simple tunic hurries in; YOU clutches the rooster in horror, then the rooster pecks seeds from YOU's hand. Two-shot as the servant points at a map of Rome; YOU exhales with a relieved smile.

scenes.text: While you wait to respawn, it's four fifty-five. The Vandals loot Rome for fourteen days. They even rip off half the gold-plated temple roof. And today, *vandal* means wrecking stuff.
scenes.visual: YOU as a translucent ghost on a 'RESPAWNING…' loading bar, watching from above. Below, the Temple on the Capitol: Vandals (tunic, cloak, RoundShield; no FurCloak) pry golden roof plates off and carry them toward ships; the right half of the Temple roof is gone. Then a dictionary-card sticker.

scenes.text: Final respawn. Four seventy-five, *nightmare mode*. You're a kid named Romulus Augustus. So Romans call you *Augustulus*. Little Augustus.
scenes.visual: Same YOU Toonie, now scaled down as a kid, drowning in the oversized ImperialCloak, LaurelWreath sliding over his eyes, feet dangling from the huge Throne. Close-up on the slipping wreath at 'little'.

scenes.text: Then, in four seventy-six, Odoacer takes your throne. You're a kid, so he spares you. And because you're pretty, he pays you six thousand gold pieces. Fired, with a *pension*.
scenes.visual: A tall Goth-style Toonie (Odoacer: tunic, cloak, Beard; no FurCloak) lifts kid-YOU off the Throne by the cloak and sets him down, then hands him a bag while Coins rain. Kid-YOU walks off toward a sunny Campania villa (RomanHouse, UmbrellaPine).

scenes.text: And your job? The Senate tells the East, one emperor is enough. Emperor of the West? *Deleted*.
scenes.visual: Senate hall: Senators in white Togas sign a Scroll and send it east together with the imperial cloak and wreath. Empty Throne in the West; a big DELETED stamp slams onto a job-ad Scroll 'EMPEROR OF THE WEST'.

scenes.text: Plot twist. Rome didn't fall in a day. Well, the East keeps going for almost a thousand more years, until fourteen fifty-three. And it still calls itself *Roman*.
scenes.visual: Camera flies east over the EmpireMap (westFall dark, east half glowing) to Constantinople; an Emperor of the East on a Throne under an SpqrBanner, TimelineStele racing up to 1453 while the HUD bar pumps back up.

scenes.text: So when did Rome fall? A, four seventy-six, or B, fourteen fifty-three? Comment A or B. Historians still argue about why. My vote? It went downhill the day someone asked,
scenes.visual: YOU (adult again, purple cloak) sits on the steps of the Colosseum facing the camera while the A/B cards slide in; at 'My vote' he leans in and the camera rushes back toward the dusk auction stage from the first shot (loop).
